content.title: Review default portfolio risk status and warning signal
content.intent: Prove the default dashboard view exposes the risk metrics, gauge state, and visible concentration warning before any interaction.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to keep the default read-only dashboard path distinct from the interactive popover path. I judged pagination, boundary, security, perf, i18n, and responsiveness techniques not applicable from the cited source because it described fixed displayed values and warning interaction only. No covering array was needed; risk-judged combinatorial strength remained 2 (no money, auth, or data-loss factors applied to the grounded behavior).
